features.description: SpamGuard: an email spam and phishing filter deployed by a 20 person company for its own shared inboxes. It classifies incoming email as ham, spam, or phishing from message text and metadata; likely spam moves to a retrievable quarantine folder and suspected phishing links are flagged for the IT admin. It never blocks, deletes, or answers mail on its own.
purposes: classify incoming email as ham, spam, or phishing
quarantine likely spam for later retrieval
flag suspected phishing links for the IT admin
